title: Why Aeye Inc (LIDR) Thinks This Hire Is a Big Deal
title_zh: 为什么 Aeye Inc (LIDR) 认为这次招聘很重要
summary: Aeye Inc (NASDAQ:LIDR) is among the best lidar stocks to buy according to analysts. The lidar stock has risen more than 20% in the past month and surged more than 180% over the past 12 months.
summary_zh: 分析师认为，Aeye Inc（纳斯达克股票代码：LIDR）是最值得购买的激光雷达股票之一。激光雷达股票过去一个月上涨超过20%，过去12个月飙升超过180%。

title: Is JPMorgan’s Olympic Banking Deal Reshaping the Global Tech-Expansion Narrative for JPMorgan Chase (JPM)?
title_zh: 摩根大通的奥运银行交易是否正在重塑摩根大通（JPM）的全球科技扩张叙事？
summary: Earlier this week, JPMorgan Chase announced it had become the first Global Banking Partner of the Olympic Games, serving as Official Bank of Team USA and the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games while also extending community-focused initiatives in Los Angeles and across the Unit...
summary_zh: 本周早些时候，摩根大通宣布成为奥运会首个全球银行合作伙伴，担任美国队和 LA28 奥运会和残奥会的官方银行，同时还在洛杉矶和整个部门推广以社区为中心的举措……

title: Blackstone Weighs India Waste Deal As Inflows Lift Assets Above US$1.3t
title_zh: 由于资金流入使资产超过 1.3 吨，黑石集团考虑印度废物交易
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) reported material inflows into its credit, insurance, and private equity divisions in Q1, lifting total assets under management above $1.3b. The firm saw withdrawals from some large private credit funds even as overall net inflows stayed positive.
summary_zh: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) 报告称，第一季度信贷、保险和私募股权部门有大量资金流入，使管理下的总资产超过 1.3b 美元。尽管总体净流入保持正值，但该公司仍看到一些大型私人信贷基金的撤资。

title: Tech ETFs: XLK Offers Lower Fees While IYW Provides Broader Tech Exposure
title_zh: 科技 ETF：XLK 提供更低的费用，而 IYW 提供更广泛的科技投资
summary: Compare how each ETF’s unique sector mix, top holdings, and dividend approach may shape the risk and reward profile for tech-focused portfolios.
summary_zh: 比较每只 ETF 独特的行业组合、最高持股和股息方法如何影响以科技为重点的投资组合的风险和回报状况。

title: BASF Coatings Launches $2 Billion Debt Sale To Fund Carlyle Acquisition
title_zh: 巴斯夫涂料公司启动 20 亿美元债务出售，为凯雷收购提供资金
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Banks have moved to launch a debt sale exceeding $2 billion tied to the carve-out of BASF SE's (BASFY) coatings division, a deal that could offer a timely read on investor appetite for chemicals exposure.
summary_zh: 本文首次发表于 GuruFocus。银行已着手启动一项超过 20 亿美元的债务出售，与剥离巴斯夫股份公司 (BASFY) 涂料部门相关，这项交易可以及时了解投资者对化学品敞口的兴趣。
